title: Visual Rule Builder
description: Each rule reads like a sentence: "When a job has capabilities [X] and risk tags [Y] then [Decision] because [reason]". Build rules by: + Add Rule → pick match conditions from dropdowns → choose decision → type reason. AND/OR logic. Drag-and-drop priority ordering. Conflict detection. Live stats inline.
definitionOfDone: Visual rule builder as DEFAULT policy editing interface
Each rule rendered as a readable card/sentence
Add Rule button opens builder: match conditions (capabilities dropdown, risk tags dropdown), decision selector (4-option color-coded: Allow/Deny/Require Approval/Throttle), reason text input
AND/OR logic toggle per rule (all of these / any of these)
Live stats inline per rule (triggered N times in 24h + sparkline)
Conflict detection: warning if higher-priority rule shadows this one

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/RuleCard.tsx: Single rule rendered as a readable sentence card. Format: 'When a job has capabilities [cap1] [cap2] and risk tags [tag1] then [Decision] because [reason]'. Capabilities and risk tags as inline Badge components. Decision as large color-coded Badge. Reason as italic text. Inline stats: 'triggered N times in 24h' + mini sparkline. Drag handle on left for priority reordering. Edit button opens inline editing mode. Delete button with confirmation.

Create dashboard/src/components/policy/RuleEditor.tsx: Inline rule editor form. Match conditions: capabilities dropdown (multi-select, options populated from API or packs), risk tags dropdown (multi-select). Logic toggle: 'all of these' (AND) / 'any of these' (OR) switch. Decision selector: 4 large color-coded buttons (Allow/green, Deny/red, Require Approval/yellow, Throttle/orange) — only one selected. Reason text input. Uses React Hook Form + Zod validation (decision required, at least one match condition). Save/cancel buttons.

Create dashboard/src/components/policy/VisualRuleBuilder.tsx: Container component. Uses usePolicyRules(). Renders ordered list of RuleCard components. 'Add Rule' button at bottom opens empty RuleEditor. Drag-and-drop reordering via HTML5 drag events (onDragStart/onDragOver/onDrop) — updates rule priority order. On reorder, calls useReorderPolicyRules() mutation. Conflict detection: after reorder, scan rules top-to-bottom; if a lower rule's match criteria is a subset of a higher rule's, show warning badge 'This rule may never fire — rule #N matches first'.
Integrate VisualRuleBuilder as 'Builder' tab (DEFAULT active tab) in PolicyPage.tsx.
